Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: movable transparent PNG character asset for an academic research website.
Input image 1 is ONLY a style reference: simple colorful hand-drawn cartoon bouldering, saturated flat colors, organic bold black ink outlines. Create an ORIGINAL new character; do not reproduce the reference composition or watermark.
Primary request: exactly ONE male cartoon boulderer, alone on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Full body, single character, no duplicates.
Subject: young adult boy with a teal baseball cap, dark navy-blue short-sleeved shirt, orange trousers, small dark climbing shoes. Charming simplified face, black hair visible under cap, natural human anatomy.
Pose: side-on three-quarter view, actively bouldering and reaching upward toward the RIGHT. Right arm extends upward-right; other arm reaches nearer his body; one knee bends and the opposite leg extends downward-left, as in a convincing balanced bouldering move. Hands and feet touch empty air so separate website rock holds can be positioned behind them later.
Style: flat editorial hand-drawn illustration matching the reference's playful black ink contour aesthetic, clean crisp black outlines, very little shading, solid colors, no 3D.
Composition: portrait 2:3 canvas, entire figure visible with generous transparent margin, clean silhouette, no cropping.
Constraints: absolutely no climbing wall, no rock holds attached to hands or feet, no ropes, no harness, no ground, no environment, no shadows outside the figure, no other people, no scientific symbols, no text, no watermark. Preserve genuine transparent alpha; do not draw a checkerboard or white backdrop.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent PNG spritesheet of climbing holds for clickable research-paper projects on a website.
Input image 1 is ONLY a style reference: playful flat colorful climbing illustrations with bold hand-drawn black ink outlines. Create original rock holds; do not copy watermark or composition.
Primary request: EXACTLY EIGHT distinct large physical rock-climbing holds, on a genuinely transparent alpha background, arranged in an EXACT 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows grid. Wide 2:1 overall canvas so all 8 cells are square. One centered separate hold per cell. Each hold fits within the central 65–70% of its square cell with at least 15% transparent padding all around. No overlap, no grid lines, no labels, no extra objects or tiny holds. Designed for background-position sprite extraction with equal cells.
Style: large organic irregular physical climbing-hold silhouettes, bold black ink outlines, flat saturated colors, minimal inner facets, simple readable abstract scientific patterns drawn as thin dark ink lines INSIDE each hold. Every silhouette and color is different. These are physical rock holds, not generic icons.
Reading order, left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row:
1. Magenta rounded asymmetrical hold with a sparse graph/network of connected dots, suggesting quantum magic.
2. Teal oblong faceted hold with three gently braiding path tracks, suggesting qubit routing.
3. Mustard yellow broad squat hold with stacked contour-like density-wave bands, suggesting nonlinear state estimation.
4. Violet triangular rounded hold with a small layered-node lattice, suggesting learning and generalization.
5. Turquoise vertical rounded hold with a bilateral mirrored abstract motif, suggesting symmetry.
6. Orange broad uneven hold with dots clustered densely on one side and sparse on the other, suggesting localization and inverse participation ratio.
7. Indigo bean-shaped hold with concentric returning circular arcs and one discreet directional arrow, suggesting reversing an unknown unitary.
8. Coral red long rounded hold with comb-like parallel slots inside, suggesting quantum combs.
Constraints: EXACTLY 8 holds, precisely 4 columns × 2 rows, each centered within its cell, no labels, no equations, no pretend physical results, no characters, no people, no wall, no ropes, no decorative symbols outside the rocks, no border, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background, no white backdrop and no drawn checkerboard.
